scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter frontend dev" "pnpm --filter backend start:dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter backend lint
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis minio minio-init
